levels.name: Word problems
levels.description: Hand-written. Edit data/algebra.json to add more.

questions.q: A number plus 9 is 23. What is the number?
Three times a number is 51. What is the number?
Maya has twice as many stickers as Leo. Together they have 36. How many does Leo have?
questions.hint: Let Leo have x. Then Maya has 2x, and x + 2x = 36.

questions.q: A taxi charges $3 plus $2 per mile. A ride cost $19. How many miles was it?
The perimeter of a rectangle is 30. Its length is 9. What is its width?
Five less than four times a number is 27. What is the number?
Sam is 4 years older than Ana. The sum of their ages is 30. How old is Ana?
questions.hint: Let Ana be x. Then Sam is x + 4.

questions.q: Half of a number, plus 7, equals 15. What is the number?
A number doubled, plus 6, is 20. What is the number?
Pens cost $3 each. Ava bought some pens and a $5 notebook and spent $26. How many pens did she buy?
Three whole numbers in a row add up to 48. What is the smallest?
questions.hint: Call them x, x + 1 and x + 2.

questions.q: A rectangle is 3 longer than it is wide. Its perimeter is 34. How wide is it?
questions.hint: Width x, length x + 3. Perimeter = 2(x + x + 3).

questions.q: Leo is 5 years younger than Mia. Together they are 27. How old is Leo?
questions.hint: Let Leo be x. Then Mia is x + 5.

questions.q: A number is divided by 5, then 3 is added. The result is 11. What is the number?
Three times the sum of a number and 4 is 36. What is the number?
A gym charges $20 to join plus $15 per month. After how many months have you paid $140 in all?
I think of a number, multiply it by 4, subtract 9, and get 31. What is my number?
The sum of a number and twice that number is 45. What is the number?
A bus has 12 more adults than children. There are 52 passengers in all. How many children?
questions.hint: Let the children be x. Then adults are x + 12.

questions.q: Tickets cost $8 for adults and $5 for children. A family bought 2 adult tickets and some child tickets for $31 in all. How many child tickets?
A father is four times as old as his son. In 6 years, their ages added together will be 67. How old is the son now?
questions.hint: Son x, father 4x. In 6 years: x + 6 and 4x + 6.

questions.q: Two numbers add to 50. One is 14 more than the other. What is the larger number?
questions.explain: 2x + 14 = 50, so x = 18 and the larger is 32.

questions.q: A two-digit number has digits that add to 11. Reversing the digits makes it 27 bigger. What is the number?
questions.hint: Try the tens digit a and ones digit b: a + b = 11.
questions.explain: The number is 47. Reversed it is 74.

questions.q: Tom has twice as many coins as Sue. If Tom gives Sue 10 coins, they have the same number. How many coins does Tom have?
questions.hint: Sue has x, Tom has 2x. Then 2x − 10 = x + 10.

questions.q: Five whole numbers in a row add up to 85. What is the largest?
questions.hint: Call the middle number m: the five are m − 2 to m + 2.
questions.explain: The middle one is 17, so the largest is 19.

questions.q: Ben has 24 coins, all nickels (5 cents) and dimes (10 cents), worth $1.70 in all. How many dimes does he have?
questions.hint: Let the dimes be d. Then nickels are 24 − d.

questions.q: A farm has only chickens and rabbits. They have 20 heads and 56 legs in all. How many rabbits?
questions.hint: Let the rabbits be r. Chickens are 20 − r.

questions.q: Sam is 3 times as old as Dee. In 5 years Sam will be twice as old as Dee. How old is Dee now?
questions.hint: Dee x, Sam 3x. In 5 years: x + 5 and 3x + 5.

questions.q: Triple a number, minus 7, equals double the number plus 5. What is the number?
The length of a rectangle is twice its width. Its perimeter is 48. What is its area?
Sara spends half her money on a book, then $6 on lunch, and has $9 left. How much money did she start with?
questions.explain: Before lunch she had 15, which is half her money. She started with 30.

questions.q: When 7 is subtracted from three times a number, the result is the same as when the number is added to 11. What is the number?
A tank is 1/3 full. After 20 more liters go in it is 5/6 full. How many liters does the full tank hold?
questions.hint: The 20 liters fill 5/6 − 1/3 of the tank.

questions.q: Train A goes 60 km per hour. Train B goes 80 km per hour on the same track and leaves the station 1 hour later. How many hours after B leaves does it catch A?
questions.hint: They are at the same distance when 60(t + 1) = 80t.

questions.q: Maya has $50 and saves $8 each week. Leo has $98 and spends $4 each week. After how many weeks do they have the same amount?
Three even numbers in a row add up to 78. What is the largest?
questions.hint: Call them x, x + 2 and x + 4.
questions.explain: 3x + 6 = 78, so x = 24 and the largest is 28.
